title: Retention Wizard — Compact Console UI for per-route TTL, evidence preview, and legal-hold
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Problem: Customers need a fast, low-friction way to configure retention for prompts/responses/request logs/metrics per-route and per-tenant without opening the full policy authoring UI. Current console screens are powerful but dense, which leads engineers to default to global TTLs or request SRE help — increasing support load and compliance risk.

Goal: Design a compact, step-driven "Retention Wizard" embedded in the Console route settings that surfaces common presets, visualizes downstream evidence bundles, supports temporary legal-hold tagging, and provides a quick export preview. The wizard must preserve the full policy expressiveness (link out to policy authoring), but enable 3-click common flows for platform engineers and PMs.

Scope (what this ticket covers):
- Compact modal + inline settings in per-route "Data lifecycle" panel.
- Preset selector (Short / Default / Long / Custom) with clear cost and residency hints.
- Legal-hold toggle with ephemeral hold duration and audit note input.
- Evidence preview pane that shows a signed, time-limited sample export manifest (no actual export).
- Canary validation: quick lint that surfaces conflicting org-level policies and cross-region residency constraints.
- Accessibility: keyboard-first flow, screen-reader labels for residency/resolution fields.

Out-of-scope: full policy expression language editor (link-out only), bulk-apply across >50 routes (handled by API/CLI ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Wizard is accessible from a route's Data lifecycle card and opens as a compact modal without full console reload.
Preset selection updates estimated monthly storage and sample evidence size shown in the UI within 200ms of change.
Enabling legal-hold creates a visible indicator on the route and appends audit notes in the route activity timeline.
Evidence preview renders a signed manifest (sample) that includes TTL, residency, and a hashed sample of fields, without performing export.
Wizard runs a quick validation that surfaces policy conflicts and a single-click 'open full policy editor' link.
All interactive elements pass WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard and label checks in our accessibility audit.
Design handoff assets (Figma frames, tokens, and interaction spec) are delivered and accepted by ENG and PM reviewers.
implementation_notes: Use compact card layout to reuse existing console tokens; prefer collapsing secondary details behind a 'more info' affordance.
Evidence preview is a client-side signed JSON view; server will provide signed manifest endpoint (ENG-33012).
Preset cost estimates are derived from Runtime pricing model; show both absolute and percent change from route baseline.
When legal-hold is enabled, UX must surface immutable bead indicating hold start date and owner; removal requires two-step confirmation and audit note.
